name: Backyard Night
description: Suburban home front entrance at night viewed from an elevated drone-like angle. A car pulls into the driveway with headlights creating light trails, while a person stands at the illuminated front porch. Warm porch lighting contrasts with dark surroundings. Landscaping lights provide ambient illumination.
